statement: Two-dimensional Erdos-Turan-Koksma inequality with main term N/H. For points z_0, ..., z_{N-1} on the torus, H >= 7, and every half-open box [a,b) x [c,d) with b - a <= 1 and d - c <= 1, |#{n < N : z_n in box} - N (b-a)(d-c)| <= 32N/(H+1) + 2 sum w(k) w(l) |S_{k,l}|, the sum over (k,l) != (0,0) with |k|, |l| <= H, where S_{k,l} = sum_n e(k x_n + l y_n) and w(k) = 1/max(1,|k|). The proof smooths with the product Fejer kernel at radius 4/(H+1) and compares translates of the expanded and contracted boxes with the extreme box discrepancy, as in the one-dimensional BTCalculus.ErdosTuran; the double kernel integral is written as two nested one-dimensional integrals. This is the discrepancy input of Paper B Proposition 3.2; the proposition itself is not yet Lean-verified.
